Specification: This module is a small model-checking wrapper around a least-circular-substring specification. It introduces two constants, one bounding the character set size and one bounding the maximum string length, and then defines finite ranges derived from those constants for use as model domains. The file does not define any state variables, actions, temporal specification, or correctness properties; it only provides simple value-level definitions intended to constrain or instantiate the imported algorithm.
